int_name: W OXFORD ST & N RANDOLPH ST

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a stop-controlled intersection in the foreground. While the narrow roadway naturally limits vehicle speeds, the pedestrian environment is degraded by faded crosswalk markings, poor pavement quality, and a lack of visible ADA-compliant curb ramps.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and near the curb creates potential trip hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb close to the intersection may block the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, mid-ground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental-style markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and properly sloped ramps at the intersection corners.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. Parked vehicles line both sides of the roadway, which may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks visible, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas without priority.

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the street may hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking in the asphalt could pose a tripping hazard or affect vehicle handling.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks with ADA-compliant curb ramps, but lacks formal crossing markings at the intersection. The narrow roadway and residential context suggest a low-speed environment, though poor pavement quality and parked cars obstructing sightlines present hazards.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks at an intersection where curb ramps are present, failing to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway can create tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbsides along the street

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Install zebra or continental style crosswalk paint to clearly delineate the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded pavement to provide a smooth, safe surface for all road users.
